Over 90 % of hospitals and physician practices in developed nations use Electronic Health Records (EHRs), centralizing vast amounts of data, which increases the risk of breaches. The rise of telehealth, which surged by 3,000 % during the COVID-19 pandemic, continues to generate more digital data that must be managed securely.

Healthcare data is growing exponentially, with a 36 % annual growth rate, and a single patient generating nearly 80 megabytes of data each year.

With breaches affecting over 133 million individuals in 2023 alone, the need for robust data security practices is urgent. Proper training is essential to protect patient data and mitigate risks.

How you manage and protect sensitive information is critical to maintaining that trust and ensuring patient safety. We guide you through the entire information lifecycle, from understanding the Legal & Ethical Frameworks of GDPR to implementing best practices in Record Keeping and Documentation. You will develop crucial skills in Information Governance and Cybersecurity, learning to identify risks and prevent data breaches before they happen.

Master the art of professional Communication and Information Sharing and learn to apply the Code of Practice on Confidential Information in your daily work.


Enroll today and become the trusted, compliant, and confident professional your patients deserve.

You will learn to apply the Five-Step Model for revenue recognition, a framework that helps businesses determine when and how much revenue to recognize. The course also provides hands-on experience with the Percentage of Completion (POC) method, a widely used approach for recognizing revenue in long-term contracts, particularly in industries like construction and engineering. You will learn how to apply the POC method to calculate and recognize revenue based on progress toward completing performance obligations.

Through real-world examples, case studies, and practical exercises, you’ll gain the confidence to navigate the complexities of IFRS 15 and ASC 606 and ensure your organization’s financial reporting is accurate and compliant. This course is ideal for anyone seeking to understand revenue recognition in a practical, straightforward manner and is especially valuable for those looking to advance their skills in the accounting and finance fields.

Enfin, vous rassemblerez tout dans la section Introduction et MLOps pratique. courseDetails.longDescription:

Bienvenido al "Bootcamp de 7 Días de Desarrollo Práctico de IA: Construye Proyectos de IA Reales Desde Cero", un curso diseñado para principiantes absolutos que desean adentrarse en el mundo de la inteligencia artificial (IA). Este curso es ideal para quienes tienen poca o ninguna experiencia previa en programación o IA, pero poseen la curiosidad y motivación para aprender. Ya seas estudiante, estés cambiando de carrera o simplemente tengas interés en construir tu primer proyecto de IA, este curso está estructurado para llevarte de cero conocimientos a desplegar modelos de IA en el mundo real.

Durante 7 días, construirás proyectos todos los días, comenzando con lo básico de la programación en Python hasta desplegar un modelo de IA completamente funcional en la web. Cada día está lleno de proyectos prácticos, aplicaciones reales e instrucciones fáciles de seguir para que no solo adquieras conocimientos teóricos, sino también habilidades aplicables de inmediato en el mundo real.

Lo que aprenderás:

Este curso cubre todo lo que necesitas para empezar en el desarrollo de IA. Cada día se centra en un nuevo tema, construyendo progresivamente sobre lo aprendido anteriormente. Aquí tienes una breve visión general de lo que puedes esperar:

Día 1: Fundamentos de Python para IA

Comenzamos con la base: programación en Python. Python es el lenguaje más popular para IA, y al finalizar el Día 1 entenderás la sintaxis básica, tipos de datos, flujo de control y cómo usar librerías esenciales como NumPy y Pandas. También construirás tu primer programa sencillo, preparando el terreno para los proyectos de IA que vienen.

Día 2: Análisis Exploratorio de Datos (EDA)

Los datos son el pilar de la IA, y antes de entrenar modelos, debes saber analizarlos. En el Día 2 aprenderás a limpiar, manipular y visualizar datos. Usando librerías como Matplotlib y Seaborn, explorarás conjuntos de datos, manejarás datos faltantes y visualizarás relaciones entre características. Trabajarás con datos reales para descubrir patrones ocultos.

Día 3: Introducción al Aprendizaje Automático (Machine Learning)

En el Día 3, nos sumergimos en el aprendizaje automático con un enfoque en regresión lineal. Aprenderás los fundamentos del aprendizaje supervisado, incluyendo cómo dividir tu conjunto de datos en entrenamiento y prueba, entrenar un modelo y evaluar su desempeño. Al final del día, construirás tu primer modelo predictivo para predecir variables continuas como precios de viviendas.

Día 4: Modelos de Clasificación en Machine Learning

Luego, abordarás problemas de clasificación usando regresión logística. Ya sea prediciendo si un correo electrónico es spam o clasificando la pérdida de clientes, este día te enseñará a construir un modelo de clasificación y evaluarlo con métricas como precisión, recall y exactitud. También interpretarás matrices de confusión para analizar el rendimiento de tu modelo.

Día 5: Redes Neuronales y Deep Learning

El Día 5 introduce el fascinante mundo de las redes neuronales. Construirás una red neuronal feedforward simple para clasificar dígitos manuscritos usando el conjunto de datos MNIST. Trabajarás con librerías como TensorFlow o PyTorch y aprenderás conceptos clave como funciones de activación, retropropagación y entrenamiento de modelos de deep learning.

Día 6: Procesamiento de Lenguaje Natural (NLP)

El Día 6 se centra en el Procesamiento de Lenguaje Natural (NLP), donde construirás un modelo de análisis de sentimientos usando datos de texto. Aprovecharás modelos preentrenados de Hugging Face o crearás el tuyo propio con TensorFlow para clasificar texto como positivo o negativo. Aprenderás sobre preprocesamiento de texto, tokenización y transferencia de aprendizaje en NLP.

Día 7: Despliegue de un Modelo de IA como Servicio Web

En el último día, aprenderás a desplegar tus modelos de IA como servicios web usando Flask. Integrarás tus modelos en una aplicación web para que los usuarios puedan interactuar a través del navegador. Además, desplegarás tu app en plataformas en la nube como Heroku. Al final del día, tendrás una aplicación web impulsada por IA accesible para cualquier usuario.

A pitch deck is a concise and visually engaging presentation that is typically used in business settings to convey a company's or project's key information, value proposition, and investment opportunity. Pitch decks are primarily used when seeking investments, partnerships, or to secure new clients. They serve as a persuasive tool to convey the essence of your business or idea quickly and effectively. A well-crafted pitch deck can make a significant difference in the success of a business, startup, or project.

Here are the key components and the needs of usage for a pitch deck in a business context:

  1. Introduction: Start with a compelling introduction that grabs the audience's attention and provides an overview of your business or project.

  2. Problem Statement: Clearly define the problem or need that your product or service addresses. This sets the stage for why your business is relevant.

  3. Solution: Present your solution and how it addresses the identified problem. Explain how your product or service works and what makes it unique.

  4. Market Opportunity: Describe the market size and potential for your business. This includes the target audience and its demographics.

  5. Business Model: Explain how your business will generate revenue, your pricing strategy, and the sales channels you plan to use.

  6. Traction: Showcase any significant achievements, customer testimonials, or partnerships to build credibility.

  7. Competitive Analysis: Identify your competitors and explain how your business is positioned relative to them. Highlight your competitive advantages.

  8. Team: Introduce your team and their relevant experience. This builds trust and confidence in your ability to execute the business plan.

  9. Financial Projections: Present your financial forecasts, including revenue, expenses, and profitability projections. This demonstrates the potential for a return on investment.

  10. Ask: Clearly state what you are seeking from your audience, whether it's investment, partnership, or something else.


The skills related to pitching, business presenting, and business communication are important for experts and companies for several reasons:

  1. Securing Funding: Effective pitching skills are crucial when seeking investments or funding. A well-presented pitch deck can significantly increase the chances of attracting investors.

  4. Client Acquisition: In sales and client-facing roles, effective presentation and communication skills can help in acquiring new clients or customers. It can make the difference between a successful pitch and a missed opportunity.

  5. Career Advancement: For individuals, mastering these skills can lead to career advancement. Professionals who can effectively communicate their ideas and lead presentations tend to stand out and progress in their careers.

  6. Team Collaboration: Effective communication and presentation skills are essential for collaboration within teams. They help in conveying objectives, sharing updates, and ensuring everyone is on the same page.


Strong understanding of pitching, business presenting skills, and business communication skills is crucial in today's competitive business environment. These skills not only enable companies to attract investments, win clients, and build credibility but also support the career growth of individuals.
